storyCards.headline: Crying: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Roy Orbison's "Crying" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Crying" is a song written by American singer, songwriter, and guitarist Roy Orbison and Joe Melson for Orbison's third studio album of the same name (1962).

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 16 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "The Very Best Of Roy Orbison" (1966) — not the song's original release year.

Album: The Very Best Of Roy Orbison (1966).

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
